helpers.note: the engine's own number for a BlockEffect variant at the bindings and in a world checkpoint; BlockEffect is the engine's tag for a block's movement behaviour, which vanilla keeps as Block subclasses, not numbers
inverse of BlockEffect::code: decodes the engine's binding/checkpoint number of a block effect, refusing an unknown one; no vanilla counterpart
setter replacing the list of entity boxes the caller supplies for entity_collisions (which cites EntityGetter#getEntityCollisions); storing them is engine state, vanilla reads live entities
whether the engine's moving_blocks map holds the cell (set by set_moving_block); a lookup into the engine's own store of piston block entities, callers cite the vanilla behaviour they gate on it
stores a cell's VersionedBlockStateId (no-op in a chunk marked unloaded); engine bookkeeping of which generated table entry a cell came from
reads back the stored VersionedBlockStateId through loaded_cell (none in an unloaded chunk); a getter of engine state
stores the caller's block-entity kind string for a cell (no-op in a chunk marked unloaded); engine metadata, not a vanilla BlockEntity
removes the stored block-entity kind of a cell (no-op in a chunk marked unloaded); engine metadata plumbing
returns the stored property list of a cell through loaded_cell, empty when none or unloaded; a getter of engine storage

removes a cell and everything the engine keeps for it (extra shapes, properties, state id, block entity, chunk and section indexes); the engine's store maintenance, vanilla sets air through LevelChunk and set_block carries that citation
whether the engine store holds a readable block for the cell (through loaded_cell); distinguishes absent from explicit air, a distinction vanilla does not have
whether the engine's section index (explicit or with blocks) has the 16-cube section, never in a chunk marked unloaded; an engine index query for the bindings
marks or unmarks a section as explicitly present in the engine's section index; engine bookkeeping for the bindings
number of cells the engine's section index holds for a section, 0 in a chunk marked unloaded; an engine index count, not vanilla's LevelChunkSection non-empty count
whether the cell's chunk is in the engine's unloaded set, which the engine's writes check to leave it alone; a lookup into engine state
moves a chunk between the engine's loaded and unloaded sets as the caller says; a setter of engine state standing for the client's chunk cache
getter returning the stored build heights, border centre and size as a tuple; engine state accessor
stores a block with one box list used as its collision, outline and interaction shapes (delegates to set_block_shapes_with_geometry); engine storage of shapes the caller computed
stores a block with separate collision and outline box lists, the outline also as interaction shape (delegates to set_block_shapes_with_geometry); engine storage plumbing

stores a block with its collision, outline and interaction box lists, the first box of each in the BlockState and the rest in the extra maps; no-op in an unloaded chunk. Engine storage of caller-computed shapes
records on a moving-block cell the direction it moves and the base it keeps, which through_moving_blocks (citing PistonMovingBlockEntity#getCollisionShape) reads; a setter of engine state
getter of the base boxes stored by set_moving_block_noclip for a cell, empty when none; engine state accessor
drops the engine's moving-block record of a cell and the shape it gave the stored block, when the caller says the block entity ended; engine store maintenance
converts an engine VoxelShape's boxes into the stored BlockShape list (none for an empty shape) and stores the block; a conversion between engine types
the stored BlockState of a cell through loaded_cell, the default (air) when none or unloaded; a lookup into the engine's own store, the unloaded rule cited on loaded_cell
the flow vector stored with the block at a cell, which the caller computed; an accessor, the engine does not compute FluidState.getFlow here
the engine's BlockEffect tag of the stored shape at a cell (None without one); a lookup of the engine's own classification of blocks

the first stored block whose non-empty box meets the 1e-6 slab under the box, or a shape-less effect block over it; an engine lookup with no caller outside tests and supporting_block_effect. It reproduces no vanilla method: vanilla's support is CollisionGetter.findSupportingBlock, which supporting_block_position mirrors
whether the cell's stored collision boxes include a non-empty one; a query of the engine's shape store, its callers cite the vanilla tests they make with it
the cell's stored non-empty collision boxes moved to the cell; a read of the engine's shape store with a translation, its callers cite their vanilla methods
returns the stored collision, outline and interaction box lists of a cell so the caller can rewrite it unchanged; engine store plumbing
the cell's stored non-empty outline boxes moved to the cell; a read of the engine's shape store, the ray clips that use it cite their vanilla methods
all stored outline boxes meeting a query box, sorted, over loaded chunks; a world query for the bindings, vanilla has no box query of outline shapes (it reads a block's shape per cell)
all stored interaction boxes meeting a query box, sorted, over loaded chunks; a world query for the bindings with no vanilla box-query counterpart
iterator over a cell's stored collision BlockShapes, the first and the extra ones; data structure plumbing of the engine's shape store
Display of MinecraftVersion as its release name, the patch left out when 0; a formatting helper

unit (x, z) direction of the held movement keys in the engine's axes (right and back positive), zero when none; called by no engine code, the movement input the engine runs is computed and gated in simulation.rs with its own citations
